scientific_question: Within the same frozen Qwen3-8B, CRUXEval, and rank-8 intervention laboratory, does the closed Q2 V4.1 A0 relational association generalize to prospectively sampled, safety-conditioned fresh controller identities?

design.selection: first 16 candidates passing both frozen safety shells in immutable generation order

generation.basis: exact frozen Q2 V4.1 rank-8 SPARK1_SUBSPACE_Q.npy

candidate_stream_integrity.reason: unused reserve geometry is not the inferential object; only corruption, rank loss, near-duplication, or historical overlap stops the stream

safety.backend: Spark 1 only after separate principal authorization
safety.selection: first 16 passing both shells in generation order

predicted_power.effect: 50% of closed Q2 V4.1 A0 aggregate rho
predicted_power.reason: eligible banks were ceiling-saturated at the half-prior effect and the calculation depends on a synthetic response model; it did not protect a failure mode beyond the inference-aligned geometry gates

presemantic_label_free.A0: primary and fully precomputed from selected coefficients against the frozen 31-reference bank
presemantic_label_free.A1: secondary using the frozen V4.1 whitening fit
presemantic_label_free.A2: secondary fresh label-free capture; pre-semantic-outcome but not pre-intervention
presemantic_label_free.A1_A2_qualification: inherit V1 lock; failure stops before semantic execution
presemantic_label_free.D2: secondary according to the inherited frozen definitions

fresh_old_primary.statistic: equal-weight mean of MEDIUM and STRONG complete fresh-by-reference Spearman correlations

permutation.action: P_pi A0 against fixed Dshape; all 31 reference columns remain fixed
permutation.null: conditional on the frozen reference bank, fresh-controller geometry-row labels are unrelated to the corresponding fresh-controller semantic rows, while preserving complete within-row, shared-reference, shared-item, and cross-shell dependence

bootstrap.cluster: all fresh and reference controllers, both shells, and both rollout banks for each sampled item move together

stability.leave_one_fresh_controller_out: every aggregate A0 rho strictly positive
stability.leave_one_reference_controller_out: complete descriptive report, not a terminal requirement

secondary_metrics.multiplicity: Holm correction across A1 and A2

fresh_fresh_secondary.statistic: equal-weight mean across shells of strict-upper-triangle Spearman correlations

permutation.action: P_pi A0 P_pi^T against fixed Dshape

fresh_fresh_secondary.bootstrap: same 10000 item-cluster resamples as the primary; all conditions and rollout banks for a sampled item move together
fresh_fresh_secondary.stability: every leave-one-fresh-controller upper-triangle aggregate rho strictly positive
classification_precedence: FRESH_FRESH_NO_ASSOCIATION if aggregate rho <= 0 OR controller-QAP p > 0.05
FRESH_FRESH_ASSOCIATION_POSITIVE if rho > 0, QAP p <= 0.05, item-bootstrap lower bound > 0, and every LOFO rho > 0
FRESH_FRESH_ASSOCIATION_INCOMPLETE otherwise when rho > 0 and QAP p <= 0.05 but bootstrap or LOFO support fails
fresh_fresh_secondary.precheck_clarification: The precedence above resolves an outcome-free logical overlap in the precheck wording; it does not use or alter any semantic result.

radial_secondary.positive_rule: median > 0 AND exact one-sided sign p <= 0.05 (for K=16, at least 12 positives if there are no ties) AND item-bootstrap lower bound > 0

terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_SAFE_BANK_INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 16 of 34 candidates pass both safety shells
terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_SELECTED_BANK_NOT_QUALIFIED: selected-bank inference-aligned geometry or observed amplitude gate fails
terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_READY_FOR_PREDICTION_LOCK: all presemantic gates pass; semantic execution still requires separate authorization
terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE: future authorized semantic schedule cannot be completed
terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_A0_PASS: fresh-old P1 AND P2 AND P3 AND P4
terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_ASSOCIATION_INCOMPLETE: fresh-old aggregate A0 rho > 0 and at least one permutation/bootstrap/LOFO support requirement fails
terminal_states.Q2_OOS_V2_NO_REPLICATION: fresh-old aggregate A0 rho <= 0 OR row-permutation p > 0.05

claim_boundary.allowed_positive: Within the same frozen Qwen3-8B, CRUXEval, and rank-8 intervention laboratory, the previously discovered A0 relational geometry generalizes to prospectively sampled, safety-conditioned fresh controller identities.
claim_boundary.fresh_fresh_addition: A positive secondary strengthens only the within-laboratory fresh-controller identity claim by placing both dyad endpoints in the new bank.

planning.interpretation: synthetic planning evidence only; null FPR uncertainty is reported and does not use semantic outcomes

projected_compute.A2_capture: requires future outcome-free throughput preflight; no canonical elapsed-time estimate exists
